case_scope: United States noncompete and worker mobility

workplace_power_gate.note: The FTC noncompete rule is not in effect; mobility must be proven through state law, contract practice, antitrust enforcement, and de facto restraint evidence.

noncompete_or_mobility_restraint.note: A national pass is barred because the federal noncompete rule was vacated/abandoned and cannot carry worker mobility.

job_switching_claimability.note: Job switching is the threshold moment; certification requires evidence on noncompetes, forfeiture-for-competition, repayment clauses, no-poach restraints, licensing, immigration lock-in, and local monopsony.

labor_market_monopsony.note: Even where explicit noncompetes are limited, concentrated labor markets and buyer power can make exit non-real.

proof_debt: prevalence of de facto restraints including repayment/TRAPs and forfeiture-for-competition
worker awareness and chilling effects after rule vacatur

gate_14_workplace_power.why: Worker mobility is not nationally secured after the FTC rule vacatur; proof must shift to state, contract, and enforcement evidence.

gate_11_enforcement.why: Mobility rights fail if workers cannot cheaply contest restraints before the job-switching threshold is lost.

evidence_debt_register.question: state-by-state enforceability and income thresholds
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Build a state-law matrix for enforceability, income thresholds, notice rules, choice-of-law limits, and remedy availability.

evidence_debt_register.question: de facto restraint prevalence
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure repayment agreements, training-cost clauses, forfeiture-for-competition clauses, no-poach restraints, and benefit/visa lock-in.

evidence_debt_register.question: worker awareness and chilling effects after vacatur
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Collect survey and enforcement data on whether workers believe they can leave after the federal rule failed.

evidence_debt_register.question: job-switching and wage effects
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Tie mobility restrictions to wage growth, search radius, occupation, and new-firm formation.

evidence_debt_register.question: case-level enforcement outcomes
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Track FTC/state AG/private enforcement outcomes for mobility-restraint theories after the rule vacatur.

policy_pathway: Score worker mobility as a current-law perimeter: federal rule absent, state rails uneven, de facto restraints central.
Demonstrate enforceability limits, pre-threshold remedies, and measurable job-switching/wage gains across worker groups.
